ReviewNotes: Source: ArtDirection/Character Database/Pre-Release-Character.csv, CSV row 19; release label: Pre-Middle.
The source provides one value per Skill and Ultimate. That value is preserved across ranks 1-3 and Ultimate tiers C0-C5 until progression data is supplied.
The source omits Evade, Perception, Control, Avoidance, and level growth. The four secondary fields use the project neutral defaults; growth uses CharacterStatGrowth defaults.

The source describes Crit scaling continuously with lost HP. The current passive mapping applies a 50% Crit bonus below half HP. The ultimate stun uses the listed 40% proc chance; its additional Crit-based chance is preserved in the source description.
